_search_mode: keyword = term search + BM25 (standard library). hybrid = keyword + semantic search (needs ./setup.sh --semantic). Overridden by app.py --search-mode.

semantic._about: Hybrid mode only. Semantic search proposes up to top_k policy sentences per element with cosine similarity >= min_similarity; the same 7 gates decide. Calibrated on the Marenthal data.
